purpose: Feasibility screen for further research investment; neither confirmatory success nor a population certificate

development.exact_group: sha256 of decoded RGB dimensions and bytes, matching source grouping
development.cross_source_exact_overlap: STOP before candidate or gate scoring; no silent exclusions
development.within_painting_conflicting_labels: retain official rows and labels, keep the whole identical-content group together, disclose complete conflict census
development.partition_assignment: SHA256(salt + group_id) integer in [0,2^256): DEV_fit below floor(3*2^256/5), DEV_radius below floor(4*2^256/5), otherwise DEV_check
development.group_order: within each partition, sort by SHA256(order_salt + group_id), then group_id; group members in original official-list order
development.packing: successive whole groups until U minimum, then V minimum, then E minimum; repeat; incomplete final cell is an explicitly inventoried unscored tail fixed before outcomes, never reshuffled

candidate.description: Protocol-adapted entropy-minimization candidate, not an official online Tent replication
candidate.reset: fresh complete source checkpoint and optimizer every cell
candidate.trainable_parameters: BatchNorm2d affine weight and bias only
candidate.adaptation_inputs: U images only; no labels, V or E
candidate.ordering: fixed inventory order, final short batch retained
candidate.preprocessing_all_windows: PIL RGB; torchvision Resize(256), CenterCrop(224), ToTensor, ImageNet mean [0.485,0.456,0.406] and std [0.229,0.224,0.225]; no random augmentations
candidate.rng: No stochastic augmentation, candidate search or randomized cell order; fixed source seed zero, deterministic group ordering; MPS arithmetic is not asserted bitwise deterministic
candidate.update_loss: mean softmax entropy using batch statistics
candidate.deployment_state: recreate every source running mean/variance/counter buffer even if Tent set it to None; enable running-stat tracking; restore source BatchNorm momentum and epsilon; freeze all gradients and eval mode; verify every non-affine parameter and all buffers exactly equal source; only adapted BN affine values may differ
candidate.nonfinite_or_state_mutation: STOP_ERROR; no dropped cells or replacement candidate

gate.evidence_inputs: U update diagnostics and V images only; never E inputs/labels
gate.entropy_definition: arithmetic mean over V images of -sum_c softmax(logits)_c * log_softmax(logits)_c, natural logarithms/nats; frozen and candidate evaluated in their fixed deployment states
gate.disagreement_definition: fraction of V images whose candidate and frozen argmax labels differ; PyTorch first-index tie handling
gate.prediction_state: exact same candidate deployment state for V evidence and E predictions; verify no parameters or buffers change during inference
gate.update_normalization: L2 changed BN affine parameters divided by max(source BN affine L2 norm, 1e-12)
gate.fit: existing frozen standardized ridge implementation; transformations fitted on DEV_fit only
gate.radius: absolute residual exact-rank split conformal from DEV_radius only
gate.infeasible_radius: ABSTAIN, retain frozen; unavailable diagnostic, not certified FREEZE
gate.actions: strict positive lower endpoint ADAPT; strict negative upper endpoint FREEZE; otherwise ABSTAIN
gate.no_radius_ablation: same frozen fitted predictor, radius zero; descriptive comparator only

sequence: review and freeze source pilot settings; train one final source model
validate painting metadata/content/grouping and freeze complete partitions/windows before scores
freeze candidate, features and analysis settings plus executable identities before any painting outcome score
run U-only candidates, V-only evidence and fixed-model E predictions for DEV_fit and DEV_radius, then score only these development partitions
use only DEV_fit outcomes to fit the predictor and DEV_radius outcomes to fix residual radius; seal estimator identity before DEV_check decisions
run each DEV_check candidate on U, construct evidence on V, write its action, then obtain fixed-model E predictions without labels; seal all check actions and prediction pairs
join DEV_check labels only after every check action and its E prediction pair has been sealed; never revise original decisions
custody_scope: Label-free model/feature APIs and stage-separated scoring; ingestion process reads DEV labels. Not independent custody or production OS-enforced label isolation. Reserved sketch/real remain unacquired.

metrics.primary_benefit: paired candidate minus frozen top-1 accuracy on the same cell E images
metrics.cell_weighting: equal complete-cell weights; also disclose actual row denominators and sample-weighted summaries
metrics.secondary: aggregate class-macro recall over present E classes with counts and absent-class disclosure
metrics.inferential_claim: descriptive one-checkpoint, one-development-domain screen; no population risk, independent-environment or robust beats-both claim
metrics.directional_ties: ADAPT with delta <= 0 is false adaptation; FREEZE with delta >= 0 is false freezing; delta == 0 counts toward either wrong strict claim, but contributes zero regret
metrics.oracle_headroom: min(mean(max(delta,0)), mean(max(-delta,0))) over complete equally weighted check cells
metrics.leave_one_cell: remove each check cell in turn and recompute both baseline-minus-KGA mean regret gaps using original sealed actions; no refit, recalibration or action revision

go_no_go.ERROR_STOP: invalid identity, class mapping, cross-source exact duplicates, unreadable/nonfinite data, incomplete scored cell or state/receipt integrity failure; the predeclared inventoried unscored packing tail is not an error
go_no_go.NO_DEMONSTRATED_OPPORTUNITY: valid complete check panel fails predeclared mixture or oracle-headroom screen; specific to this candidate/source recipe
go_no_go.INCONCLUSIVE_GATE: opportunity exists but any gate/exposure/error/leave-one-cell criterion fails
